mentl/a542d45:
Per HC-handler-composition.md: transform handlers emit; materialize
handler captures; ~> composes.

Four list-producing fns (map, filter, take, drop) split into
transform-handler + collector materializer:

- handler map_h(f) — re-yields f(elem)
- handler filter_h(pred) — re-yields iff pred(elem)
- handler take_h(n) with remaining = n — re-yields while remaining>0
- handler drop_h(n) with skipped = 0 — re-yields after skipping n

- handler collector with buf = make_list(16), count = 0 — captures
  every yield via list_extend_to + list_set (Ω.3 buffer-counter);
  result() returns slice(buf, 0, count)

fn bodies become ~> chains:
  fn map(f, xs)    = { iterate(xs); result() } ~> map_h(f)    ~> collector
  fn filter(p, xs) = { iterate(xs); result() } ~> filter_h(p) ~> collector
  fn take(n, xs)   = { iterate(xs); result() } ~> take_h(n)   ~> collector
  fn drop(n, xs)   = { iterate(xs); result() } ~> drop_h(n)   ~> collector

Scalar-producing fns (fold, for_each, any, all, find, count) keep
their inline form — their state is scalar; no drift-11.
